ps all significant digits and pads to at least two decimals. The three visible tests pass. I couldn't see the hidden tests.

The README's two requirements conflict for some inputs. "Exactly two decimal places" can't hold for an amount like 1.234 NEAR, because showing only `1.23` would hide value and break `parseNear(formatNear(x)) === x`. I put the round-trip rule first, since the README says it must hold for every input. So `1.5` becomes `1.50` and `2` becomes `2.00`, but `1.234` stays `1.234`. If the hidden tests expect strict two-decimal rounding on such amounts, this will fail them.
